h: Woli Agba and Dele Omo Woli reportedly take legal action over claims linking them to Toluwanisings' death
p: Gospel singer Woli Agba and Dele Omo Woli have reportedly begun legal steps over online claims that connect them to the death of singer Toluwanisings. The late singer died on 14 October, and speculation about the circumstances has been circulating since.
more: Woli Agba had earlier urged the public not to jump to conclusions while the singer was unwell.
The singer's father has also spoken publicly about his son's death.
Fans continue to pay tribute to the late gospel artiste.
